explication: Kaset is a native macOS client for YouTube Music and YouTube. Users browse or search music and video, choose content, and play it through native player controls; they can also manage queues and their library. The app adds lyrics, equalization, podcasts, discovery, Apple Intelligence features, and macOS integrations. The graph groups these capabilities by product subsystem. Several internal connections are documented by the README or SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementations limit confidence about finer call paths.
